composition: Tall freestanding brick campanile beside the Romanesque abbey on the Po Delta plain · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the flat fields the camera faces the abbey complex: the tall freestanding brick campanile rises on the left with its rows of arched openings, while the Romanesque abbey church stretches to the right and cloister buildings sit between. Green fields of the Po Delta plain spread all around under the thin-clouded 08:28 morning sky.
